limits: Strict profile C core imports actual FDSlot/fd_move/FDPool; hosted allocation, clocks, libc and sanitizers are verification dependencies only.
Eight native compiler/optimization profiles, one actual i386 ABI and four CortexM4 final-link audits; target images are not executed.
Invalid effective-type/restrict uses remain analysis-only. The may_alias experiment is a named GCC/Clang extension, not ISO C.
Truthful allocator size/alignment and actual allocated storage are preconditions; no portable validation of arbitrary pointers or malicious callbacks.
Fallible destructor failure retains resources; callbacks must preserve retryability and cannot reenter or retain freed storage.
Generation collision is a bounded logical token demonstration, not evaluation of a pointer after C lifetime ends.
Four timing experiments retain240 raw samples each and equal disjoint correctness contracts; no universal speedup, hardware timing stability or mastery claim.
N1570 C11 draft and N2219/N2263 nonnormative proposals are distinct; published C17/C23 remain source gaps.
External review, independent delayed learner attempts and physical observation are unperformed.
